state.purpose: Adversarial generator/schema review. Judge concrete candidate mechanisms; source and executable tests remain authoritative. The same supported application JSON configuration must be represented consistently in HTTP binding and its schema.

keyword_permission_property_emits_invali.instructions: Can a valid escaped request property named @event or @class referenced by a RequiresPermission token be emitted as typed.event or typed.class without escaping, yielding invalid generated C#?

openapi_name_ignores_resolved_member_met.instructions: Can runtime binding accept a resolver-renamed JSON property custom while OpenAPI still advertises and requires the original property name value because body schema names bypass JsonPropertyInfo?

openapi_reuses_runtime_member_resolution.instructions: Does the supplied OpenAPI body loop reuse the same resolved per-member JSON metadata as runtime binding?
